svg.title: Жим гантелей нейтральным хватом — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. STANDING NEUTRAL-GRIP TWO-DUMBBELL SHOULDER PRESS. Palms face EACH OTHER, parallel dumbbell handle axes, elbows forward rather than flared wide. Left: dumbbells beside shoulders, elbows bent pointing slightly forwards, palms facing inward. Right: press both dumbbells overhead while maintaining inward-facing neutral grip; torso upright, feet floor, no bench. Three-quarter view so grip is unmistakable. Distinguish from wide pronated press. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
